title: fix(etag): stabilize digest across stream chunks

expectedFindings.description: A partial chunk is kept with `value.subarray(offset)`, a view on the producer's buffer, across `reader.read()` calls. A producer that reuses its buffer overwrites those bytes before they're hashed, so the ETag is wrong (e.g. [A, B] hashed as [B, B]).

mustNotSkip.reason: The new chunk-buffering loop and final flush.

evidence.note: Fix PR: "This regression was introduced in #5205". Changes `subarray(offset)` to `slice(offset)` on this line.
